{{Top|leg}}
A '''Synthesized Byrothsis lens''' was a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] [[Focusing lens/Legends|focusing lens]] created using Byrothsis, a compound that was originally used to create infrared camera lenses. The resulting focusing lens was capable of strengthening the lightsaber beam, although the wielder of the blade had a more difficult time deflecting enemy [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolts.
